courses.title: Natural Self Confidence
courses.description: A guided hypnosis recording by Carol Erickson and Tom Condon in their 'Multi-Evocation' style, which layers several voices. It leads the listener into a natural setting to find a sense of confidence, personal power and self-esteem and to work towards their goals. The authors recommend it to newcomers to their audio programmes.

courses.title: Self Hypnosis
courses.description: A guided trance recording by Carol Erickson and Tom Condon that takes the listener to an imagined place of their own choosing. It is meant as a relaxing time out for easing stress, setting new goals, strengthening inner resources and finding fresh perspectives.

courses.title: Quick Stress Busters
courses.description: Four short guided trances by Carol Erickson and Tom Condon for moments of rest in a busy day: an imagined tropical resort, a mountain meadow, a deeply peaceful inner state, and a neck-and-shoulder massage in 3-D sound. Each stands alone and serves as an introduction to their recordings.

left_out: Deep Sleep (https://www.thechangeworks.com/cwproducts/deepsleep.html): the page is built around insomnia and quotes a review calling it 'A perfect substitute for sleeping pills'; that suggests replacing medication, so still out.

Rapid Pain Control (https://www.thechangeworks.com/cwproducts/rapid_pain_control.html): offered as a 'drug-free adjunct to conventional treatment of pain', including 'chronic pain that drugs can't touch'; a treatment claim for chronic pain, so still out (borderline).
Sensible Weight Loss (https://www.thechangeworks.com/cwproducts/weight_loss1_2.html): a programme to help listeners lose weight and with compulsive eating; a health-treatment programme, still out.
Smoking-cessation programme named in the hypnosis page's heading: no product page linked from it, not looked for further.
Creativity, Intuition and Easy Learning recordings on the same hypnosis page: not health items in the original notes, so not checked here.
flags: The three restored recordings are co-authored with Carol Erickson (L.C.S.W., M.F.C.C.); Tom Condon is named on each page. They are hypnosis audio rather than spiritual teaching in the narrow sense; listed under life coaching like his other items. Pages are old (footer copyright 1997-2011 or 1997-2019), but the products are still offered with prices.

Price shown on each page as '$9.95 / $14.95' (probably download / CD; the page doesn't say which). The pages have no product images; the dry run picked the site's navigation-bar banner (images/navbar2010.jpg), so each item uses the healer's own photo (images/tom1.jpg, from the original plan) and images_final is set to true so the ingest keeps it.
Offerings after this plan: 6 of 10 if the original 3 are still live.
